title: The Dog Register
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 146
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the visitor judges one of the night's 28 pages before being told whether it was rewired, then sees the verdicts of two judges, a reader and an added judge; a wiring of the register's twelve column names under one fresh maker's work running live beside its untouched parent; the night's 24 mutants, the family, the judges' meanings, the predictions. A figure (figure.svg); briefs, makers' reports, rooms, rebind-core.js (experiment 31's operator), blind codes, the practice's verdicts, scoring.
embodies: Judging a data work that cannot be checked from memory. Swapping whole columns of Zürich's dog register under one maker's coat-colour page, a fresh judge without the register refused every page that changed and passed every true one; a judge with the register beside it read it and said the same; a judge shown only the lying pages refused them all against their own subtitles. The norm was written into each page by its maker.
result: W (no register) refused 18 of 18 rewired pages and passed 10 of 10 true ones; WT (register beside it) gave identical verdicts after parsing the register; W1 (only the 18) refused 18 of 18 citing each page's own subtitle or caption; V (checking against the register) called all 18 false. The practice passed 8 of the 18 as works.
project_step: Thirty-second experiment of the project. Operation: judging (with varying). Takes from experiment 31 its whole arrangement and operator unchanged (four plain makers, a parent drawn by seed, 24 column swaps in arms U, T, S, blind coder X, fresh judge W, reader V) and its open thread 2 (a table the judge cannot check from memory), and adds a judge with the data beside it (WT) and, after the results, a judge shown only the lying pages (W1). Finds that the judge's norm is neither memory nor contact with the data but the page's own written promises. Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing (performance against alleged competence, ATP 12-13) and the standing sentence's 'already'.
material: Stadt Zürich, Hundekontrolle der Stadtpolizei, 'Aktueller Hundebestand der Stadt Zürich', reference day 2026-09-30, 10,106 dogs, Open Data Zürich, CC0; CSV fetched 2026-10-21 from https://data.stadt-zuerich.ch/dataset/sid_stapo_aktueller_hundebestand_monat_od1003/download/KUL100OD1003.csv (sources/MANIFEST.json). Twelve of 35 columns kept under their published names. Domain: a city's register of dogs (companion animals and their keepers).
seed: parent draw, mutants (rebind-core.js, mulberry32) and coder orders seed 146; W1's order seed 1461; PNG nonces from the system's random source; agents are model instances and not seeded; the face's chance swaps and its order of pages take a seed from the visitor's browser
